preview: We look at Meta’s plan to have an AI agent handle phone calls for users. The idea sounds convenient, but it also raises questions about what happens behind the scenes and what users should know before they trust the service. By the end, you’ll understand the concern at the center of this plan.
comment_1: Listen for what Meta was trying to let its AI agent do for users.
comment_2: Meta wanted its AI agent, Muse, to make phone calls for users. But who was really making those calls?
comment_3: This story shows a gap between how the phone service appeared and how it worked in testing. Now, let’s look more closely at that gap and the concerns it brought up.
comment_4: So far, this story has raised two connected questions: how much human help may be involved, and how much people know about it. Now, let’s bring these ideas together and hear the main point.
